title: 2003 AMC 10B 9
statement:
Find the value of \(x\) that satisfies the equation

\[25^{-2} = \dfrac{5^{\frac{48}{x}}}{5^{\frac{26}{x}} \cdot 25^{\frac{17}{x}}}.\]

solutions.text:
Writing everything base \(5,\) the left side is \(5^{-4}\) and the right side is \[5^{\frac{48-26-34}{x}}=5^{-\frac{12}{x}}.\] Setting exponents equal, \(-4=-\dfrac{12}{x},\) so \(x=3.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Rewrite every term as a power of \(5\)
The right side becomes \(5^{\frac{48-26-34}{x}};\) set the exponent equal to \(-4\)
